title: Utility Line Protection Plans Rate Card: Public-Way Scope Rates
content:
# Rate Card: Public-Way Scope Rates

Allowance rate card for public sidewalk, curb and street restoration under the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

Public-way scope rate: where the plan replaces whole lines after repeat breaks, which is when its full replacement break count is above zero, and the most recent completed repair on the same line was completed no more than the plan's replacement lookback days before the request date, the public-way restoration figure takes the whole-line public-way rate; for a recall where those two conditions do not both hold, it takes the re-opening public-way rate; every other request takes a public-way scope rate of one. The public-way scope rate multiplies the plan's public way restoration allowance in the public-way restoration figure.

## Plan figures

| Plan | Full-replacement break count | Replacement lookback |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | 0 | 0 days |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | 2 | 730 days |

## Rates

| Break count above zero, and last completed repair on the same line within the lookback | Request type | Public-way scope rate |
|---|---|---|
| both hold | any | 1.25 (whole-line public-way rate) |
| not both | recall | 0.5 (re-opening public-way rate) |
| not both | new failure | 1 |

## Boundary cases (a plan with a 730-day lookback)

- Last completed repair on the line 730 days before the request date: both conditions hold, rate 1.25. Completed 731 days before: they do not; a recall takes 0.5 and a new failure takes 1.
- No completed repair on the line on record: the conditions do not both hold.

## Hypothetical examples (an allowance of $4000.00 assumed)

- Both conditions hold: $4000.00 multiplied by 1.25 is $5000.00.
- Recall, conditions not both met: $4000.00 multiplied by 0.5 is $2000.00.
